teaches.en: The smallest complete app. Read main.js top to bottom and you know the framework.
teaches.zh: 最小的完整範例。把 main.js 從頭讀到尾，整套框架就懂了。

summary.en: The smallest complete app. Read its main.js from top to bottom and you know the framework.
summary.zh: 最小的完整範例。把 main.js 從頭讀到尾，整套框架就懂了。

plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 電腦鍵盤 · 模擬演奏者

alt.en: Bursts of thin green and red particle trails falling on black.
alt.zh: 黑底上，粒子拖著細細的綠色與紅色尾巴落下。

en: Click the on-screen piano, or tick “keyboard” and play A to L: every note launches a burst.
Tick “simulate performance”, then drag the Hue and Gravity sliders while it plays.
Press Space to play the timeline: the same params now move on their own.
zh: 點螢幕鋼琴，或勾選 keyboard 用 A 到 L 彈：每個音都放出一團粒子。
勾選 simulate performance，在它彈奏時拖動 Hue 與 Gravity 推桿。
按空白鍵播放時間軸：同樣的參數，現在自己動了。

note.en: Params: what the piece can be performed with.
note.zh: 參數：這件作品能被什麼演奏。

note.en: A struck note is an event, so it may come straight from a signal.
note.zh: 按下的音是事件，可以直接從訊號來。

note.en: One createShow() call brings piano, mapping, timeline, console, sound and backstage.
note.zh: 一次 createShow() 呼叫，就帶來鋼琴、映射、時間軸、控台、聲音和後台。

teaches.en: A plain p5 sketch whose first line loads oav-p5.js, then plays from a MIDI controller, an on-screen controller or a phone.
teaches.zh: 一份普通的 p5 草圖，第一行載入 oav-p5.js，就能用 MIDI 控制器、螢幕上的控制器或手機彈。

summary.en: A plain p5 sketch whose first line loads oav-p5.js, then plays from a MIDI controller, an on-screen controller or a phone.
summary.zh: 一份普通的 p5 草圖，第一行載入 oav-p5.js，就能用 MIDI 控制器、螢幕上的控制器或手機彈。

plays.zh: MIDI 控制器 · 螢幕上的控制器 · 手機

alt.en: A flower of layered green and yellow petals with coloured circles around it and four tall red, green and blue beams.
alt.zh: 一朵綠黃色層層花瓣的花，周圍有彩色圓圈，還有四道紅、綠、藍色的光柱。

en: Click the 🎹 at the bottom right, then turn a knob, hit a pad, press a key.
Click 📱 Phone in that panel and scan the QR code: your phone becomes the controller.
Press “Copy the line” and paste it as the first line of your own sketch.
zh: 點右下角的 🎹，轉旋鈕、敲打擊墊、按琴鍵。
點面板裡的 📱 手機，掃 QR code：你的手機就是控制器。
按「複製這一行」，貼在你自己草圖的第一行。

note.en: Line 1 is the whole integration.
note.zh: 第一行就是全部的接線。

note.en: knob1 reads like mouseX: 0..1, nothing to set up.
note.zh: knob1 像 mouseX 一樣讀：0 到 1，不用設定。

read.match: function padPressed(n, velocity) { ring(n, velocity); kick =

note.en: Pads call padPressed(n, velocity), keys call notePressed(note, velocity): the same idea as keyPressed().
note.zh: 打擊墊呼叫 padPressed(n, velocity)，琴鍵呼叫 notePressed(note, velocity)：概念和 keyPressed() 一樣。

teaches.en: startSound('piano') in setup(): every key from a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen or a phone is heard, and bursts into particles.
teaches.zh: 在 setup() 寫 startSound('piano')：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的 🎹、手機彈的每個音都聽得到，也炸開一團粒子。

summary.en: startSound('piano') in setup(): every key from a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen or a phone is heard, and bursts into particles.
summary.zh: 在 setup() 寫 startSound('piano')：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的 🎹、手機彈的每個音都聽得到，也炸開一團粒子。

plays.zh: MIDI 鍵盤 · 螢幕上的控制器 · 手機

alt.en: Streaks of green, purple and red particle dots bursting over black, above an on-screen MiniLab 3 controller with its keys and sound buttons.
alt.zh: 黑底上，綠、紫、紅色的粒子點一串串炸開，下方是螢幕上的 MiniLab 3 控制器，有琴鍵和聲音按鈕。

docs.en: Sound: what is played is heard
docs.zh: 聲音：彈什麼就聽到什麼

en: Click the page once (browsers keep sound off until then), then play the keys of the controller that opens at the bottom.
Pick another instrument in that panel: marimba, strings, a synth. 🔊 turns the sound off and on.
Hit a pad: notes on MIDI channel 10 play the drum kit, not the piano.
zh: 先點一下畫面（瀏覽器要點過才出聲），再彈下方打開的控制器上的琴鍵。
在面板裡換樂器：馬林巴、弦樂、合成器。🔊 可以關掉、再打開聲音。
敲打擊墊：第 10 軌的音打鼓，不會彈成鋼琴。

note.en: The one line. Everything below it is plain p5.js.
note.zh: 那一行。它下面全是普通的 p5.js。

note.en: Sound on, and the controller on screen open: two calls in setup().
note.zh: 開聲音、打開螢幕上的控制器：setup() 裡兩行。

note.en: Every note, from any of the three inputs, calls notePressed(): the pitch picks the colour and the place, the velocity how far it bursts.
note.zh: 三種輸入彈的每個音都呼叫 notePressed()：音高決定顏色和位置，力度決定散多開。

teaches.en: micLevel, bass and beat read the microphone the way p5 reads mouseX: a circle that grows when you speak, and no p5.sound.
teaches.zh: micLevel、bass、beat 像 mouseX 一樣讀麥克風：說話時圓會變大，不用 p5.sound。

summary.en: micLevel, bass and beat read the microphone the way p5 reads mouseX: a circle that grows when you speak, and no p5.sound.
summary.zh: micLevel、bass、beat 像 mouseX 一樣讀麥克風：說話時圓會變大，不用 p5.sound。

plays.zh: 麥克風 · 鼓機（🥁）

alt.en: A large pink circle with a thin grey ring around it on dark blue.
alt.zh: 深藍底上一個大大的粉紅色圓，外面圍著一圈細細的灰色圓環。

en: Allow the microphone when the browser asks, then talk, clap or play music: the circle grows with how loud it sounds.
A low voice or a bass line turns the colour towards magenta: that is bass.
No microphone? 🎹 → 🥁 starts the drum machine: each kick and snare sets beat, and the ring bursts.
zh: 瀏覽器問的時候允許麥克風，然後說話、拍手或放音樂：圓跟著聽起來多大聲變大。
低沉的聲音或貝斯，顏色會往紫紅走：那就是 bass。
沒有麥克風？🎹 → 🥁 開鼓機：每個大鼓、小鼓都讓 beat 變成 true，外圈彈出一圈。

note.en: bass and micLevel: 0 to 1, read like mouseX.
note.zh: bass 和 micLevel：0 到 1，像 mouseX 一樣直接讀。

note.en: beat is true for one frame on each beat, like mouseIsPressed.
note.zh: beat 在每個拍子的那一格是 true，像 mouseIsPressed。

note.en: micIsOn: until the microphone runs, say what to do.
note.zh: micIsOn：麥克風開好之前，告訴看的人要做什麼。

title.en: p5 lag: smooth a jumpy value
title.zh: p5 lag：讓跳動的數值變順

teaches.en: lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) smooths a jumpy value the way TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP does, in the same seconds; scope() plots both in a corner of the page.
teaches.zh: lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 把跳動的數值變順，跟 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 一樣，秒數也一樣。scope() 在網頁角落畫出兩條線。

summary.en: lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) smooths a jumpy value the way TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP does, in the same seconds; scope() plots both in a corner of the page.
summary.zh: lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) 把跳動的數值變順，跟 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 一樣，秒數也一樣。scope() 在網頁角落畫出兩條線。

plays.zh: 麥克風 · 鼓機（🥁）

alt.en: A small green circle (micLevel) and a larger yellow one (lagged) over two traces: the green drops at once, the yellow falls slowly. A small scope sits in the corner.
alt.zh: 左邊小小的綠色圓（micLevel），右邊比較大的黃色圓（lag 後），下面兩條曲線：綠色一下就掉，黃色慢慢落下。角落有一個小示波器。

docs.en: Values over time: lag, env, speed, spring, trail

en: Allow the microphone and clap: the left circle (micLevel) jumps, the right one (lagged) opens at once and closes slowly, like a VU meter.
Watch the scope in the corner and the strip below: green is micLevel, yellow is lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4).
Nothing to hear? 🎹 → 🥁 plays drums through the speakers, and a laptop's own microphone hears them.
zh: 允許麥克風，拍一下手：左邊的圓（micLevel）一抖一抖，右邊的圓（lag 後）立刻撐開、慢慢收，像 VU 表。
看角落的示波器和下面那一條：綠色是 micLevel，黃色是 lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4)。
身邊沒有聲音？🎹 → 🥁 讓喇叭打鼓，筆電自己的麥克風就聽得到。

note.en: One call in draw(), nothing to declare: 0.03 s up, 0.4 s down.
note.zh: draw() 裡一行，不用宣告：上升 0.03 秒、下降 0.4 秒。

note.en: scope(value, 'label'): a plot in a corner of the page, never in a recording.
note.zh: scope(value, 'label')：畫在網頁角落，不會錄進影片。

note.en: trail() keeps the last 3 seconds and drawTrail() draws them on the canvas, so a recording has them.
note.zh: trail() 留住最近 3 秒，drawTrail() 把它畫在畫布上，錄影也錄得到。

teaches.en: On-screen controllers that move with the real ones you plug in.
teaches.zh: 螢幕上的控制器，會跟著你接上的實體控制器一起動。

summary.en: On-screen MiniLab 3, LPD8, Launchpad and nanoKONTROL2. Plug the real one in and the on-screen one moves with your hands.
summary.zh: 螢幕上有 MiniLab 3、LPD8、Launchpad、nanoKONTROL2。接上實體控制器，螢幕上那台會跟著你的手一起動。

plays.en: MIDI controller, or the on-screen one
plays.zh: MIDI 控制器，或螢幕上那一台

alt.en: A spiral of pink and blue dots above an on-screen MIDI keyboard controller.
alt.zh: 粉紅與藍色圓點排成螺旋，下方是螢幕上的 MIDI 鍵盤控制器。

en: Play the on-screen MiniLab 3 with the mouse: knobs, pads, keys and strips all move the work.
Pick another device (LPD8, Launchpad, nanoKONTROL2): the same params follow, because every device has its own routes table into them.
Plug in a real controller in Chrome or Edge: the one on screen moves with your hands.
zh: 用滑鼠彈螢幕上的 MiniLab 3：旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵和觸控條都會帶動作品。
換成另一台（LPD8、Launchpad、nanoKONTROL2）：同樣的參數照樣跟著動，因為每台都有自己的路由表接到它們。
在 Chrome 或 Edge 接上實體控制器：螢幕上那台會跟著你的手一起動。

note.en: One routes table per device, all into the same params.
note.zh: 每台一張路由表，全都接到同一組參數。

note.en: modules.midi.controllers puts the controller on screen; modules.remote makes the phone one too.
note.zh: modules.midi.controllers 把控制器放上螢幕；modules.remote 讓手機也能當控制器。

teaches.en: Triads bloom, clusters decay. The world listens to chords, never to keys.
teaches.zh: 和弦語意：三和弦開花，音堆凋零。世界聽的是和弦訊號，從來不看琴鍵。

summary.en: A note drops a seed, a triad opens flowers along the branches, a cluster makes them droop and fall. The branches are The Last Input's own L-system plants. The world listens to chord signals, never to keys.
summary.zh: 一個音落下一顆種子，三和弦讓枝條開花，音堆讓花與葉垂下、落盡。枝條是《The Last Input》的 L-system 植物。世界聽的是和弦訊號，從來不看琴鍵。

plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 電腦鍵盤 · 模擬演奏者

alt.en: Slender branching plants in a night garden, with green leaves and small blue, red and pink flowers.
alt.zh: 夜裡的花園，細長分岔的植物長著綠葉，枝端開出藍、紅、粉色的小花。

en: Play a triad: flowers open along the branches.
Play a cluster of adjacent keys: branches droop and the petals fall.
Do nothing: the gardener plays itself until you touch a key.
zh: 彈一個三和弦：枝條上開出花。
彈幾個相鄰的琴鍵（音堆）：枝條垂下，花瓣落盡。
什麼都不做：園丁會自己彈，直到你碰琴鍵。

note.en: The world subscribes to chord events, not to keys.
note.zh: 世界訂閱的是和弦事件，不是琴鍵。

note.en: A triad blooms, a mild dissonance sends wind, a cluster decays.
note.zh: 三和弦開花，輕微的不協和吹起風，音堆凋零。

credit.en: Branch language © Che-Yu Wu, <cite>The Last Input</cite>, 2026
credit.zh: 枝條語言 © 吳哲宇，<cite>The Last Input</cite>，2026

rights.en: Used here as a demo, all rights reserved. The framework is MIT.
rights.zh: 在這裡當作示範，版權所有。框架採 MIT 授權。

teaches.en: A 2020 voice-controlled WebGL sketch; mic bands or the built-in drum machine play it.
teaches.zh: 2020 年用聲音控制的 WebGL 作品。低頻推動柱體，高頻讓旋轉閃爍，大鼓一下就換一組配色。

summary.en: A 2020 voice-controlled WebGL sketch. Lows pump the towers, highs shimmer the spin, a kick turns the palette.
summary.zh: 2020 年用聲音控制的 WebGL 作品。低頻推動柱體，高頻讓旋轉閃爍，大鼓一下就換一組配色。

plays.zh: 麥克風 · 鼓機

alt.en: A sphere packed with colourful cylinders seen end-on, like umbrellas.
alt.zh: 一顆球體擠滿彩色圓柱，從端面看去像一把把傘。

en: Turn on 🎤 mic in the L1 panel and clap or sing: lows pump the towers, highs shimmer the spin.
No microphone? The drum machine plays it: a kick turns the palette.
Drag Pump or Density in the params panel to hear and see what each one does.
zh: 在 L1 面板打開 🎤 mic，拍手或唱歌：低頻推動柱體，高頻讓旋轉閃爍。
沒有麥克風？用鼓機彈它：大鼓一下就換一組配色。
在參數面板拖動 Pump 或 Density，看每一個參數做什麼。

note.en: Mic bands and drum onsets reach the params, one route each.
note.zh: 麥克風的頻段與鼓的起音，各自一條路由接到參數。

read.match: modules: { keys: false, drums: true, audio: 'mic', sound: fa

note.en: audio: 'mic' switches the analyzer on; drums: true brings the stand-in.
note.zh: audio: 'mic' 開啟分析器；drums: true 帶來替身。

rights.en: Artwork © Che-Yu Wu, used here as a demo, all rights reserved. The framework is MIT.
rights.zh: 作品 © 吳哲宇，在這裡當作示範，版權所有。框架採 MIT 授權。

teaches.en: Fingers as an instrument: pinch, fists, four pattern families.
teaches.zh: 手指就是樂器：一組捏合控制鬆緊，另一組長出手臂，兩手握拳就綻放。

summary.en: Fingers as an instrument: one pinch sets tightness, another grows arms, both fists bloom. Four pattern families: mandala, lissajous, spirograph, web.
summary.zh: 手指就是樂器：一組捏合控制鬆緊，另一組長出手臂，兩手握拳就綻放。四種圖案輪流切換：曼陀羅、利薩如、萬花尺、蛛網。

plays.zh: 鏡頭（手）· 螢幕鋼琴 · 鼓機

alt.en: A blue and white mandala of fine layered lines.
alt.zh: 藍白色細線層層疊成的曼陀羅。

en: Turn on 🖐 hands. Pinch thumb and index of your right hand: the figure tightens. Pinch thumb and middle finger: it grows arms.
Close your left fist: the pattern changes between mandala, lissajous, spirograph and web.
No camera? Play the on-screen piano: the notes move the figure too.
zh: 打開 🖐 hands。右手拇指捏食指：圖形變緊；捏中指：長出手臂。
握起左拳：圖案在曼陀羅、利薩如、萬花尺、蛛網之間切換。
沒有鏡頭？彈螢幕鋼琴：音符一樣會帶動圖形。

note.en: The piano works without a camera.
note.zh: 沒有鏡頭，鋼琴照樣能彈。

note.en: Each pinch reaches a param through a route: the world never reads the hand.
note.zh: 每個捏合都經過一條路由接到參數：世界從不直接讀手。

teaches.en: A Leap Motion as an instrument; the mouse is a simulated hand when you have none.
teaches.zh: 把 Leap Motion 當樂器，經本機橋接；沒開橋接時用滑鼠模擬手。

summary.en: A Leap Motion as an instrument through the local bridge; the mouse simulates hands when no bridge runs.
summary.zh: 把 Leap Motion 當樂器，經本機橋接；沒開橋接時用滑鼠模擬手。

plays.en: Leap Motion · mouse as a simulated hand
plays.zh: Leap Motion · 用滑鼠模擬手

alt.en: A violet hand skeleton above green and blue ink strokes that fall like rain on black.
alt.zh: 黑底上，一副紫色的手骨架，上方是像雨一樣垂落的綠色與藍色墨跡。

en: No sensor? The page falls back to the simulator after two seconds (or press “simulate” in the L1 panel): the mouse is your right palm, its height sets energy and its position sets hue.
Press the mouse button to pinch: a ring of ink starts at the index fingertip.
Hold Shift for the left hand and right-click for a fist: the ink falls.
zh: 沒有感測器？頁面會在兩秒後改用模擬（或在 L1 面板按 simulate）：滑鼠就是你的右手掌，高度決定 energy，左右位置決定 hue。
按住滑鼠鍵就是捏合：食指指尖會畫出一圈墨。
按住 Shift 是左手，按右鍵是握拳：墨會落下。

note.en: Drawing the hand is the one place a world reads the input directly.
note.zh: 畫出手，是世界唯一直接讀輸入的地方。

note.en: The gestures reach the world through params: the timeline or a MIDI knob can play them too.
note.zh: 手勢經由參數送進世界：時間軸或 MIDI 旋鈕也能彈它們。

teaches.en: The phone is the instrument panel; the surface grows from the world's params.
teaches.zh: 手機就是樂器面板。世界只宣告參數，手機上的控制面板依參數自動長出來。

summary.en: The phone is the instrument panel. The world only declares params, and the control surface on the phone grows from them. Needs node serve.js on your network.
summary.zh: 手機就是樂器面板。世界只宣告參數，手機上的控制面板依參數自動長出來。需要在你的網路裡跑 node serve.js。

plays.zh: 手機或 iPad · 螢幕鋼琴

alt.en: Blue and yellow streaks exploding outward from the lower centre.
alt.zh: 藍色和黃色的光束，從畫面下方中央向外爆開。

en: Run node serve.js on your network, then type the phone URL shown at the top left into a phone on the same wifi.
On the phone's 控制台 tab move a fader: the matching param moves here.
Tilt the phone to change Drift, knock on it for a Burst. Without a phone, the on-screen piano plays notes.
zh: 在你的網路裡跑 node serve.js，把左上角的手機網址輸入同一個 wifi 裡的手機。
在手機的「控制台」分頁推動推桿：這裡對應的參數會跟著動。
傾斜手機改變 Drift，敲一下手機放出 Burst。沒有手機時，螢幕鋼琴照樣彈音符。

note.en: The world declares params. That is all the phone needs.
note.zh: 世界宣告參數。手機需要的就只有這些。

note.en: Phone sensors reach params through routes written once: phone/any is the latest phone.
note.zh: 手機感測器經由寫一次的路由接到參數：phone/any 指最近連上的那支手機。

teaches.en: Strudel plays in another tab and this sketch draws: every note Strudel sends to OAV Virtual MIDI calls notePressed(), and its clock turns drumPhase.
teaches.zh: Strudel 在另一個分頁演奏，這份草圖畫畫面：Strudel 送到 OAV Virtual MIDI 的每個音都呼叫 notePressed()，它的時鐘推著 drumPhase 轉。

summary.en: Strudel plays in another tab and this sketch draws: every note Strudel sends to OAV Virtual MIDI calls notePressed(), and its clock turns drumPhase.
summary.zh: Strudel 在另一個分頁演奏，這份草圖畫畫面：Strudel 送到 OAV Virtual MIDI 的每個音都呼叫 notePressed()，它的時鐘推著 drumPhase 轉。

plays.en: Strudel in another tab · on-screen controller
plays.zh: 另一個分頁的 Strudel · 螢幕上的控制器

alt.en: Soft coloured circles rising across the lower half, a yellow hand pointing up inside a thin ring, and the room oav-strudel-demo written at the bottom.
alt.zh: 下半部一排顏色柔和的圓往上飄，細圓環裡一根黃色指針朝上，底下寫著房間名 oav-strudel-demo。

docs.en: Recipe 2: Strudel plays, a p5 sketch draws
docs.zh: 配方二：Strudel 演奏，p5 草圖畫畫面

en: Open strudel.cc in another tab, paste lines 5 to 7 of sketch.js (the comment at the top, without the //) and press Ctrl+Enter: Strudel's notes rise here as circles.
Add ?room=your-name to this page's address and use the same name in Strudel: then only your two tabs share notes.
No Strudel open? Click the 🎹 and play: the same notePressed() draws them.
zh: 在另一個分頁打開 strudel.cc，貼上 sketch.js 開頭註解的第 5 到 7 行（拿掉 //），按 Ctrl+Enter：Strudel 的音符會在這裡變成往上飄的圓。
在這一頁的網址後面加上 ?room=你的名字，Strudel 那邊也用同一個名字，就只有你的兩個分頁互通。
沒有開 Strudel？點 🎹 彈幾個音：同一個 notePressed() 也會畫出來。

note.en: The room first, then the one line: pages in the same room hear each other's programs.
note.zh: 先寫房間名，再寫那一行：同一個房間的頁面，聽得到彼此的程式。

note.en: Strudel's notes arrive as notePressed(), at the moment Strudel stamped them.
note.zh: Strudel 的音符照它標的時間呼叫 notePressed()。

note.en: drumPhase follows Strudel's clock: once round a bar.
note.zh: drumPhase 跟著 Strudel 的時鐘走：一小節轉一圈。

teaches.en: noteIsDown('C4') works like noteIsDown(60): write note names (C4, c#4, Db3) wherever a note number goes; noteNumber(), noteName() and noteFreq() convert.
teaches.zh: noteIsDown('C4') 跟 noteIsDown(60) 一樣：收音符號碼的地方都能直接寫音名（C4、c#4、Db3）。noteNumber()、noteName()、noteFreq() 幫你換算。

summary.en: noteIsDown('C4') works like noteIsDown(60): write note names (C4, c#4, Db3) wherever a note number goes; noteNumber(), noteName() and noteFreq() convert.
summary.zh: noteIsDown('C4') 跟 noteIsDown(60) 一樣：收音符號碼的地方都能直接寫音名（C4、c#4、Db3）。noteNumber()、noteName()、noteFreq() 幫你換算。

plays.zh: MIDI 鍵盤 · 螢幕上的控制器 · 手機

alt.en: A yellow circle, square and triangle lit on black, labelled C4 = 60, E4 = 64 and G4 = 67, with G4 and 392.0 Hz written under them.
alt.zh: 黑底上亮著黃色的圓、方、三角，分別標著 C4 = 60、E4 = 64、G4 = 67，下面寫著 G4 和 392.0 Hz。

en: Play C4, E4 and G4 on a keyboard (or the on-screen one under 🎹): each shape lights up while its key is down.
Hold all three at once, a C major chord: the shapes spin.
Play any other key: the line under the shapes says its name and its frequency in Hz.
zh: 在鍵盤（或 🎹 打開的螢幕鍵盤）上彈 C4、E4、G4：按著的時候，對應的圖形會亮起來。
三個一起按住（C 大調和弦）：三個圖形一起轉。
彈任何別的鍵：圖形下面那一行會寫出它的音名和赫茲。

note.en: noteIsDown() takes a name as well as a number: 'C4' is 60.
note.zh: noteIsDown() 數字和音名都收：'C4' 就是 60。

note.en: noteNumber('C4') gives 60.
note.zh: noteNumber('C4') 回傳 60。

note.en: notePressed still hands you a number; noteName() writes it back as a name and noteFreq() gives Hz.
note.zh: notePressed 拿到的還是號碼；noteName() 把它寫回音名，noteFreq() 算出赫茲。

teaches.en: env('kick'), spring(), speed() and count('kick', 4) shape a number the way TouchDesigner's Trigger, Spring, Speed and Count CHOPs do: a bass drum opens a disc, a spring bounces it back, a hand turns, every fourth kick changes the colour.
teaches.zh: env('kick')、spring()、speed()、count('kick', 4) 像 TouchDesigner 的 Trigger、Spring、Speed、Count 那樣讓數值動起來：大鼓撐開圓盤、彈簧把它彈回來、指針一直轉、每 4 下大鼓換一個顏色。

summary.en: env('kick'), spring(), speed() and count('kick', 4) shape a number the way TouchDesigner's Trigger, Spring, Speed and Count CHOPs do: a bass drum opens a disc, a spring bounces it back, a hand turns, every fourth kick changes the colour.
summary.zh: env('kick')、spring()、speed()、count('kick', 4) 像 TouchDesigner 的 Trigger、Spring、Speed、Count 那樣讓數值動起來：大鼓撐開圓盤、彈簧把它彈回來、指針一直轉、每 4 下大鼓換一個顏色。

plays.zh: 麥克風 · 鼓機（🥁）

alt.en: A teal disc with a white hand and a thin ring around it, four dots under its centre and a small scope in the corner showing a bouncing line; env, spring and count values are written at the bottom.
alt.zh: 一個青綠色的圓盤，中間有白色指針，外面一圈細圓環，圓心下面四顆點，角落的小示波器畫著彈跳的曲線；底下寫著 env、spring、count 現在的值。

docs.en: Values over time: lag, env, speed, spring, trail

en: Nothing to plug in: startDrums() plays its own kicks, and the disc opens on each one and bounces back (the scope in the corner draws the bounce).
Watch the four dots under the centre: count('kick', 4) walks 0 1 2 3, and every fourth kick the colour changes.
Press space or click the canvas: trigger('boom') is an event of your own, and env('boom') sends a ring out.
zh: 不用接任何東西：startDrums() 自己打大鼓，圓盤每一下撐開、再彈回來（角落的示波器畫出那個彈跳）。
看圓心下面四顆點：count('kick', 4) 數 0 1 2 3，每數滿 4 下大鼓就換一個顏色。
按空白鍵或點一下畫面：trigger('boom') 是你自己的事件，env('boom') 讓一圈往外推。

note.en: env() is 1 right after each kick and 0 again 0.3 s later; spring() makes the radius follow it like a mass on a spring.
note.zh: env() 在每下大鼓之後是 1，0.3 秒後回到 0；spring() 讓半徑像彈簧上的重物那樣追著它。

note.en: speed() adds to the angle every second; count('kick', 4) walks 0 to 3, count('kick') is the total, so total ÷ 4 is the colour.
note.zh: speed() 每秒替角度加一點；count('kick', 4) 數 0 到 3，count('kick') 是總數，總數除以 4 就是顏色。

read.match: function keyPressed() { if (key === ' ') { trigger('boom'); return false; } }

note.en: trigger('boom') is an event of the sketch's own: env('boom') above is what hears it.
note.zh: trigger('boom') 是草圖自己的事件，上面的 env('boom') 接它。

teaches.en: OAVp5.drums.edit('bd(3,8), …') swaps the rhythm like typing it, OAVp5.drums.undo() goes back a line, OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl opens the line in Strudel; rhythmChanged() says what the line is now.
teaches.zh: OAVp5.drums.edit('bd(3,8), …') 像打字一樣換節奏，OAVp5.drums.undo() 回上一行，OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl 把這一行帶去 Strudel；rhythmChanged() 告訴你現在是哪一行。

summary.en: OAVp5.drums.edit('bd(3,8), …') swaps the rhythm like typing it, OAVp5.drums.undo() goes back a line, OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl opens the line in Strudel; rhythmChanged() says what the line is now.
summary.zh: OAVp5.drums.edit('bd(3,8), …') 像打字一樣換節奏，OAVp5.drums.undo() 回上一行，OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl 把這一行帶去 Strudel；rhythmChanged() 告訴你現在是哪一行。

plays.zh: 按鍵 1–4、Z、S · 鼓機（🥁）

alt.en: A circle of sixteen steps with a white hand on the left; on the right the rhythm line bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ cp ~ cp, hh(5,8), 'changed by: type', and the three earlier lines; the keys 1 to 4, Z and S explained at the bottom.
alt.zh: 左邊一圈 16 格、一根白色指針；右邊是節奏那一行 bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ cp ~ cp, hh(5,8)、「改自：type」和更早的三行；底下寫著按鍵 1 到 4、Z、S 的用法。

docs.en: The cells and the line edit each other

en: Press 1, 2, 3 or 4: edit() swaps the whole line, the circle and the drum card change at once, and the line is listed under it.
Press Z: undo() goes back one line, as the ↶ on the drum card does. Click a cell or type in the card's line, and rhythmChanged() still tells this page.
Press S: strudelUrl opens the same rhythm at strudel.cc in a new tab.
zh: 按 1、2、3 或 4：edit() 換掉整行，圓圈和鼓機卡馬上跟著變，那一行列在旁邊。
按 Z：undo() 回到上一行，跟鼓機卡的 ↶ 一樣。點格子或在卡上的那一行打字，rhythmChanged() 一樣會告訴這個頁面。
按 S：strudelUrl 用新分頁在 strudel.cc 打開同一段節奏。

note.en: edit() plays a line as if it were typed on the card and answers { ok, error }.
note.zh: edit() 像在卡上打字一樣換一行，回答 { ok, error }。

note.en: undo() goes back one line and says whether there was one.
note.zh: undo() 回上一行，並告訴你有沒有上一行。

note.en: strudelUrl is the line as a strudel.cc link; window.open takes it to a new tab.
note.zh: strudelUrl 是這一行在 strudel.cc 的連結，window.open 用新分頁打開。

teaches.en: A WebToe node patch performed as a World through ext() bindings.
teaches.zh: 這個世界是一張 WebToe 節點網路，操作方式接近 TouchDesigner，透過 ext() 綁定來演奏。

summary.en: The world is a WebToe node patch, TouchDesigner-style, performed through ext() bindings. WebToe is the engine, open-audiovisual is the show.
summary.zh: 這個世界是一張 WebToe 節點網路，操作方式接近 TouchDesigner，透過 ext() 綁定來演奏。WebToe 是引擎，open-audiovisual 是演出。

plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 模擬演奏者

alt.en: A node editor with noise, level and output nodes beside a grey cloud texture.
alt.zh: 節點編輯器裡有 noise、level、out 三個節點，旁邊是灰色雲霧材質。

en: Play the piano or tick “simulate performance”: each note pulses the patch.
Press Space to play the timeline: LFO speed and hue follow their lanes through Drift, Swell and Spin.
Drag Zoom in the params panel: the patch follows through ext('zoom').
zh: 彈鋼琴，或勾選 simulate performance：每個音都讓節點網路跳動一下。
按空白鍵播放時間軸：LFO speed 與 hue 沿著各自的曲線走過 Drift、Swell、Spin。
在參數面板拖動 Zoom：節點網路透過 ext('zoom') 跟著動。

note.en: The stage is a WebToe patch; params flow in as ext('name').
note.zh: 舞台是一張 WebToe 節點網路；參數以 ext('name') 流進去。

note.en: A note envelope shaped at the assembly layer becomes the pulse param.
note.zh: 在組裝層做出來的音符包絡線，變成 pulse 參數。

teaches.en: A 2023 MIDI sketch replayed through the framework, now with a Tone.js voice.
teaches.zh: 2023 年的一件 MIDI 每日創作，搬進框架重新演奏。繪圖程式碼保持原樣，雪花現在透過 Tone.js 發出聲音。

summary.en: A 2023 MIDI daily sketch replayed through the framework. The drawing code is the original. The flakes now have a voice through Tone.js.
summary.zh: 2023 年的一件 MIDI 每日創作，搬進框架重新演奏。繪圖程式碼保持原樣，雪花現在透過 Tone.js 發出聲音。

plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 模擬演奏者 · 聲音

alt.en: A glowing yellow ring of jagged petals with small circles inside.
alt.zh: 發光的黃色鋸齒花瓣圍成一圈，中間有小圓圈。

en: Play a note: each one is one flake, and the feedback zoom breathes.
Open L4 · Output and enable sound: the flakes get a voice.
Drag Zoom breathe or Hue shift in the params panel.
zh: 彈一個音：每個音是一片雪花，回饋放大會呼吸。
打開 L4 · Output 啟用聲音：雪花就有了聲音。
在參數面板拖動 Zoom breathe 或 Hue shift。

note.en: The 2023 drawing code, almost verbatim, in p5 instance mode.
note.zh: 2023 年的繪圖程式碼幾乎原樣，用 p5 的 instance mode。

note.en: sound: true is the L4 audio branch: Tone.js gives the flakes a voice.
note.zh: sound: true 是 L4 的音訊支線：Tone.js 讓雪花發出聲音。

rights.zh: 作品 © 吳哲宇，在這裡當作示範，版權所有。框架採 MIT 授權。

teaches.en: Close a finger pinch and a firework launches from that hand (2021).
teaches.zh: 2021 年的作品。手指一捏合，煙火就從那隻手的位置升空。

summary.en: A 2021 sketch. Close a finger pinch and a firework launches from that hand. The particle system is the 2021 code.
summary.zh: 2021 年的作品。手指一捏合，煙火就從那隻手的位置升空。粒子系統是 2021 年的原始程式碼。

plays.zh: 鏡頭（手）· 螢幕鋼琴

alt.en: Cyan and violet fireworks bursting over drooping coloured trails.
alt.zh: 青色和紫色的煙火，在垂落的彩色尾跡上炸開。

en: Turn on 🖐 hands and close a pinch: a firework launches at that hand, and the pinch distance sets the shell size.
No camera? Press a piano key: it launches one too.
Drag Richness or Gravity in the params panel to change the shells.
zh: 打開 🖐 hands，捏合手指：煙火從那隻手的位置升空，捏合的距離決定煙火大小。
沒有鏡頭？按一個鋼琴鍵，一樣會放煙火。
在參數面板拖動 Richness 或 Gravity，改變煙火的樣子。

read.match: // pinch-close = a launch AT that hand; pinch value rides th

note.en: A pinch closing is an edge: the launch happens at that hand.
note.zh: 捏合是一個「邊緣」：煙火就在那隻手的位置發射。

note.en: The piano also launches, so the work needs no camera.
note.zh: 鋼琴也能放煙火，所以作品不需要鏡頭。

credit.en: Che-Yu Wu, <cite>210807 Firework 花火大會</cite>, 2021
credit.zh: 吳哲宇，<cite>210807 Firework 花火大會</cite>，2021

rights.en: Artwork © Che-Yu Wu, used here as a demo, all rights reserved. The framework is MIT.
rights.zh: 作品 © 吳哲宇，在這裡當作示範，版權所有。框架採 MIT 授權。

teaches.en: Automation you can see: five lanes of keyframe curves drive a ring of light, scenes cut it, cues fire one-shot flashes.
teaches.zh: 看得見的自動化。五條關鍵影格曲線帶動一圈光點，場景負責切換，cue 觸發一次性的閃光。

summary.en: Automation you can see. Five lanes of keyframe curves drive a ring of light, scenes cut it, cues fire one-shot flashes, and any knob you touch takes over until you let go. Record a knob move to write a new curve.
summary.zh: 看得見的自動化。五條關鍵影格曲線帶動一圈光點，場景負責切換，cue 觸發一次性的閃光，你一碰旋鈕就接手，放開再還給曲線。把旋鈕的動作錄下來，就寫成一條新曲線。

plays.en: nothing: it plays itself · knobs on screen
plays.zh: 什麼都不用做，它自己會播 · 螢幕旋鈕

alt.en: A hexagonal ring of orange and yellow dots above a timeline with five curve lanes, scene blocks and a playhead.
alt.zh: 橘黃色圓點排成六邊形，下方是時間軸：五條曲線、場景區塊和一條播放頭。

en: Press Space and watch the playhead run over five lanes of curves; scenes cut, and ◆ cues fire flashes and ripples.
Drag a knob: it takes over from its lane (the amber dot is where you took it, the hollow one is where the curve would be).
Press ● to arm recording, play, and move a knob: the move is written into the lane as new keyframes.
zh: 按空白鍵，看播放頭走過五條曲線；場景切換，◆ cue 放出閃光與漣漪。
拖動一個旋鈕：它從曲線手上接手（琥珀色圓點是你接手的位置，空心圓點是曲線原本會在的位置）。
按 ● 準備錄製，播放時轉動旋鈕：你的動作會寫成這條曲線上的新關鍵影格。

note.en: One lane of keyframes per param.
note.zh: 每個參數一條關鍵影格曲線。

read.match: timeline: { total: TOTAL, automation: compile(lanes), scenes: SCENES, loop: true },

note.en: The timeline gets the lanes (each keyframe carries its curve), the scenes and a loop: nothing else in the world changes.
note.zh: 時間軸拿到曲線（每個關鍵影格自帶曲線種類）、場景與循環：世界本身完全不用動。

teaches.en: startDrums('breakbeat', 110) puts a 16-step drum machine on the page; kickDetected() and cueFired() turn its hits and its bars into the picture.
teaches.zh: startDrums('breakbeat', 110) 在頁面上放一台 16 格的鼓機，kickDetected()、cueFired() 把它的鼓點和小節變成畫面。

summary.en: startDrums('breakbeat', 110) puts a 16-step drum machine on the page; kickDetected() and cueFired() turn its hits and its bars into the picture.
summary.zh: startDrums('breakbeat', 110) 在頁面上放一台 16 格的鼓機，kickDetected()、cueFired() 把它的鼓點和小節變成畫面。

plays.zh: 鼓機 · 它的 16 格

alt.en: A yellow and orange flower of long petals below a 16-step drum grid with kick, snare, hat and clap rows.
alt.zh: 長花瓣的黃橘色花朵，上方是一台 16 格的鼓機，有大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手四排。

en: Click the page once to hear the drums (browsers start sound on a click); the hits move the flower either way.
Click cells in the grid at the top: the beat changes at once, and the petals follow.
Wait for bars 5 and 9: cue() names them, cueFired() changes the scene.
zh: 點一下畫面就聽得到鼓（瀏覽器要點過才出聲）。沒點也一樣，鼓點照樣推著花。
點上方鼓機的格子：節奏馬上換，花瓣跟著變。
等到第 5、第 9 小節：cue() 先寫好，cueFired() 換場景。

note.en: A drum machine and three cues: the whole timeline is in setup().
note.zh: 一台鼓機加三個 cue：整條時間軸都寫在 setup() 裡。

note.en: The microphone's own callbacks: take startDrums() out, turn the microphone on, and the sketch still moves.
note.zh: 跟麥克風同名的函式：拿掉 startDrums()、開麥克風，草圖照樣會動。

note.en: barStarted() on every bar, cueFired() on the bars cue() named.
note.zh: 每一小節呼叫 barStarted()，cue() 指定的小節呼叫 cueFired()。

teaches.en: startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8") writes the drums as one line of rhythm; drumPhase and beatPhase turn a hand once a bar and swell a circle on every beat.
teaches.zh: startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8") 用一行字寫鼓，drumPhase、beatPhase 讓指針一小節轉一圈、圓在每一拍鼓起來。

summary.en: startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8") writes the drums as one line of rhythm; drumPhase and beatPhase turn a hand once a bar and swell a circle on every beat.
summary.zh: startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8") 用一行字寫鼓，drumPhase、beatPhase 讓指針一小節轉一圈、圓在每一拍鼓起來。

plays.en: drum machine · one line you can edit
plays.zh: 鼓機 · 可以改的一行字

alt.en: A blue circle with a yellow hand sweeping round it, below a drum card that shows the line bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8 and its 16 steps.
alt.zh: 藍色的圓，一根黃色指針繞著它轉，上方的鼓機卡寫著 bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8 和它的 16 格。

en: Click the page once to hear it. The card at the top shows the line, and the word that sounds lights up.
Click the line on the card and change hh*8 to hh*16, or bd*4 to bd(3,8): pause, and it plays.
Make a typo: the word turns red, a card says what is wrong, and the last line that worked keeps playing.
zh: 點一下畫面就有聲音。上方的卡片顯示那一行，正在響的字會亮。
點卡片上那一行，把 hh*8 改成 hh*16，或把 bd*4 改成 bd(3,8)：停手就換。
故意打錯一個字：那個字變紅，卡片說哪裡錯，鼓機繼續打上一個能用的版本。

note.en: The rhythm is one line: bd kick, sd snare, hh hat, ~ a rest, *n n times, and a comma starts another layer.
note.zh: 節奏就是一行字：bd 大鼓、sd 小鼓、hh 鈸、~ 休息、*n 打 n 下，逗號後面是疊上去的另一層。

note.en: drumPhase: how far through the bar, 0 to 1, smooth. The hand turns once a bar.
note.zh: drumPhase：這一小節走到哪，0 到 1，連續的。指針一小節轉一圈。

note.en: 1 - beatPhase is largest as each beat starts and shrinks towards the next.
note.zh: 1 - beatPhase 在每一拍開頭最大，慢慢縮到下一拍。

teaches.en: drawRhythm() draws the rhythm on the canvas as a grid, a circle or a spiral, so a recording has it; the cells and the line on the card edit each other.
teaches.zh: drawRhythm() 把節奏畫在畫布上（格子、圓、螺旋三種），錄影錄得到。卡片上的格子和那一行字互相改。

summary.en: drawRhythm() draws the rhythm on the canvas as a grid, a circle or a spiral, so a recording has it; the cells and the line on the card edit each other.
summary.zh: drawRhythm() 把節奏畫在畫布上（格子、圓、螺旋三種），錄影錄得到。卡片上的格子和那一行字互相改。

plays.en: drum machine · its cells and its line
plays.zh: 鼓機 · 格子和那一行字

alt.en: One rhythm drawn three ways on the canvas: a ring of coloured steps with a white hand, a spiral of the last four bars, and a 16-step grid with a playhead, under the drum card.
alt.zh: 同一個節奏在畫布上畫成三種樣子：一圈彩色格子加一根白色指針、最近四小節繞成的螺旋、一條有播放頭的 16 格，上方是鼓機卡。

docs.en: The cells and the line edit each other

en: Click a cell on the card at the top: the line is rewritten the way a person would write it, and the canvas follows.
Press ↶ to step back, Copy for a startDrums("…") line, or Open in Strudel to take the same rhythm to strudel.cc.
Press R: eight seconds of the canvas and the drums, saved as one video with the rhythm drawn in it.
zh: 點上方卡片的格子：那一行字照人會寫的樣子改寫，畫布跟著變。
按 ↶ 回上一步，按「複製」拿到一行 startDrums("…")，按「在 Strudel 打開」把同一個節奏帶去 strudel.cc。
按 R：畫布連同鼓聲錄 8 秒，存成一支影片，畫上去的節奏也在裡面。

read.match: drawRhythm(width * 0.27 - s / 2, height * 0.46 - s / 2, s, s, 'circle');

note.en: 'circle': a ring of 16 steps for each drum, a hand turned by drumPhase.
note.zh: 'circle'：每種鼓一圈 16 格，指針照 drumPhase 轉。

read.match: drawRhythm(width * 0.73 - s / 2, height * 0.46 - s / 2, s, s, 'spiral', { bars: 4 });

note.en: 'spiral' winds the last 4 bars outwards; 'grid' is the card's 16 steps, in your own colours.
note.zh: 'spiral' 把最近 4 小節往外繞，'grid' 就是卡片上的 16 格，顏色可以自己給。

note.en: rhythmChanged() says the line changed (code, a cell, typing, ↶), so the canvas can show it.
note.zh: rhythmChanged() 告訴草圖那一行換了（程式、點格子、打字、↶），畫布就能跟著顯示。

teaches.en: A day of sky as segment lengths: two cuts, a hold, cues, a segment that can crash.
teaches.zh: 有結構的演出：「一天的天空」只寫一次段落長度；導演為每段跑一個模組，?cut=<id> 選版本，空白鍵放行 hold。

summary.en: A show with structure: "A day of sky" written once as segment lengths; a Director runs one module per segment, ?cut=<id> picks a version, Space continues a hold.
summary.zh: 有結構的演出：「一天的天空」只寫一次段落長度；導演為每段跑一個模組，?cut=<id> 選版本，空白鍵放行 hold。

plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 鍵盤：空白鍵、← →

alt.en: A pale moon in a blue and teal dusk sky, with the word dusk in the corner.
alt.zh: 藍色與青綠色的黃昏天空，有一輪淡色的月亮，角落寫著 dusk。

en: Press Space: the standby waits at its end (a hold). Press Space again to release it.
Open ?cut=short: the same show, half as long, from the same score.
Open ?break=dusk: the dusk module throws on purpose, the desk shows a warning and the show carries on; R brings the module back.
zh: 按空白鍵：待命段停在結尾（hold），再按一次空白鍵放行。
打開 ?cut=short：同一份總譜，同一場演出，長度減半。
打開 ?break=dusk：dusk 的模組故意出錯，控台顯示警告，演出照常進行；按 R 把模組救回來。

note.en: A cut is a list of segments with lengths, never absolute seconds.
note.zh: 一個 cut 是一串有長度的段落，絕不寫絕對秒數。

note.en: The score and its segment modules go into createShow().
note.zh: 總譜與段落模組一起交給 createShow()。

teaches.en: startRecording() saves the canvas and the sketch's own sound as one video, MP4 where the browser can write it; ⏺ and 📷 in the 🎹 panel need no code.
teaches.zh: startRecording() 把畫布連同草圖自己的聲音錄成一支影片（瀏覽器能錄 MP4 就是 MP4）。🎹 面板上的 ⏺ 和 📷 不寫程式也能用。

summary.en: startRecording() saves the canvas and the sketch's own sound as one video, MP4 where the browser can write it; ⏺ and 📷 in the 🎹 panel need no code.
summary.zh: startRecording() 把畫布連同草圖自己的聲音錄成一支影片（瀏覽器能錄 MP4 就是 MP4）。🎹 面板上的 ⏺ 和 📷 不寫程式也能用。

plays.en: QWERTY keys A–K · on-screen controller · drum machine
plays.zh: 電腦鍵盤 A–K · 螢幕上的控制器 · 鼓機

alt.en: A pink dot in the middle of glowing pink and yellow rings spreading out, below the drum card playing four on the floor.
alt.zh: 中間一顆粉紅色圓點，外面是發光的粉紅與黃色圓環往外擴散，上方是正在打 four on floor 的鼓機卡。

docs.en: Recording: a video with its sound
docs.zh: 錄影：畫面和聲音一起錄

en: Click the page once for sound, then play A S D F G H J K over the drums.
Press R to start recording and R again to stop: the video downloads, and a card says its length, its size and whether it has sound.
Press P (or 📷 in the 🎹 panel) to save the canvas alone as a PNG.
zh: 點一下畫面就有聲音，然後跟著鼓用 A S D F G H J K 彈。
按 R 開始錄，再按一次 R 停：影片會下載，卡片寫出長度、大小、有沒有聲音。
按 P（或 🎹 面板上的 📷），只把畫布存成一張 PNG。

note.en: Drums and a plucked synth: both go into the video.
note.zh: 鼓機和撥奏的合成器：兩個都會錄進影片。

note.en: R starts and stops a take; startRecording(10) would stop by itself after ten seconds.
note.zh: R 開始、再按一次停止。寫 startRecording(10) 就是錄 10 秒自動停。

note.en: recordingSaved(info): the file's name, length, size and format, once it is saved.
note.zh: recordingSaved(info)：存好之後拿到檔名、長度、大小和格式。

teaches.en: The work plus your hands plus its own sound, in one synced video. MIDI takes too.
teaches.zh: 作品疊在鏡頭畫面上，連同作品自己的聲音錄成一個直式 1080×1920 到 4K 的檔案；MIDI 演奏可錄下再重播。

summary.en: A performance video: the work above the webcam in one vertical 1080×1920 to 4K file with the work's own sound; MIDI takes recorded and played back.
summary.zh: 演出影片：作品疊在鏡頭畫面上，連同作品自己的聲音錄成一個直式 1080×1920 到 4K 的檔案；MIDI 演奏可錄下再重播。

plays.en: on-screen piano · QWERTY · simulated performer · camera (optional)
plays.zh: 螢幕鋼琴 · 電腦鍵盤 · 模擬演奏者 · 鏡頭（選用）

alt.en: Overlapping pink, yellow and green rings spreading over a dark field, each one a struck note.
alt.zh: 深色畫面上，粉紅、黃與綠色的圓環層層疊疊向外擴散，每一圈都是一個被彈下的音。

en: Pick a size and a layout (vertical 1080p, 4:5, 2.7K, 4K; stack, pip, side or work) and watch the frame change.
Press ● Rec take, play something, then ▶ Play: the show plays it back as if it were you.
Save the take as .json or .mid, or load a .mid back.
zh: 選尺寸和版型（直式 1080p、4:5、2.7K、4K；stack、pip、side、work），看畫面框怎麼變。
按 ● Rec take，彈點什麼，再按 ▶ Play：演出會把它當成你在彈一樣放回去。
把演奏存成 .json 或 .mid，或讀回一個 .mid。

note.en: A Compositor puts the work and the webcam into one canvas of an exact size.
note.zh: Compositor 把作品和鏡頭放進同一個尺寸精確的畫布。

read.match: const video = new Recorder({ canvas: comp.canvas, fps, audio

note.en: One Recorder records that canvas with the work's own sound, so picture and sound share one clock.
note.zh: 一個 Recorder 把畫布連同作品自己的聲音錄下來，畫面與聲音共用同一個時鐘。

read.match: const takeRec = new TakeRecorder({ signals, name: 'take' });

note.en: A TakeRecorder keeps what you play; a TakePlayer plays it back into the show.
note.zh: TakeRecorder 記下你彈的；TakePlayer 把它放回演出裡。

teaches.en: The performance video without a camera: the controller you play, drawn live.
teaches.zh: 不用鏡頭的演出影片：作品下方即時畫出正在彈的 MIDI 控制器（MiniLab 3 或任何設定檔），重播的演奏也會動。

summary.en: The performance video without a camera: the MIDI controller being played (MiniLab 3, any profile) drawn live under the work; replayed takes animate it too.
summary.zh: 不用鏡頭的演出影片：作品下方即時畫出正在彈的 MIDI 控制器（MiniLab 3 或任何設定檔），重播的演奏也會動。

plays.en: MIDI controller · on-screen piano · QWERTY · a demo take
plays.zh: MIDI 控制器 · 螢幕鋼琴 · 電腦鍵盤 · 一段示範演奏

alt.en: Overlapping pink, purple and yellow rings beside an on-screen MiniLab 3 with the last note written under it.
alt.zh: 粉紅、紫與黃色的圓環層層交疊，旁邊是螢幕上的 MiniLab 3，下方寫著最後彈下的音。

en: Play the piano or the QWERTY keys A to L: the controller drawn next to the work moves with them.
Press ▶ Demo take: a replayed take animates the panel exactly as the hands did.
Pick another device and a look (device colours, one accent, flat), then press ● Record.
zh: 彈鋼琴或電腦鍵盤 A 到 L：畫在作品旁的控制器會跟著動。
按 ▶ Demo take：重播的演奏讓面板動起來，就和手彈的一樣。
換一台裝置、換一種外觀（device colours、one accent、flat），再按 ● Record。

note.en: ControllerCanvas draws a controller profile; Arturia MiniLab 3 by default, any profile in the library.
note.zh: ControllerCanvas 畫出一份控制器設定檔；預設是 Arturia MiniLab 3，資料庫裡任何一台都行。

read.match: const comp = new Compositor({ size: 'vertical-1080p', layout

note.en: The panel goes into the bottom of the Compositor every frame.
note.zh: 面板每一幀都被畫進 Compositor 的下半部。

note.en: The demo is a take: a recorded clip animates the panel like live hands.
note.zh: 示範演奏是一份 take：錄好的片段讓面板動起來，就像現場的手。
